ios.desc:
Plan your renovation, track what it really costs, and keep every photo, quote and to-do in one place. Home Stories turns a kitchen remodel or a bathroom reno into a project you can actually see. Plan it on your own or together with your partner or contractor.

SHARE THE PROJECT (PRO)
- Invite a partner, a family member or your contractor
- Everyone sees the same tasks, items and photos, kept in step through iCloud
- Export a polished PDF report with a cover photo - the whole project or just the parts you need

NEW: BUILT FOR IPAD
- Your projects sit in a sidebar and the project opens beside them
- A task, item, note or document opens in an inspector alongside your work, not on top of it
- Drag photos, PDFs and links straight in from Safari, Files or Photos
- Keyboard shortcuts and pointer support

NEW: YOUR PROJECTS ON EVERY DEVICE (PRO)
- Turn on iCloud sync and your edits reach your other devices as you make them
- Start a project on iPhone, carry on planning it on iPad
- Sync stays off until you switch it on

HOW IT WORKS
1. Create a project - give it a name, a start date and a budget
2. Add tasks, items, notes and documents as you go
3. The running total and the photo timeline build themselves

TRACK THE MONEY
- Every item you save adds its price to the project total
- Budget vs. actual cost chart, so you see the overrun coming (Pro)
- Log payments and keep materials, labour and contractor costs apart
- Works in your own currency

SAVE WHAT YOU FIND
- Spot a sink in the store: snap it, add the price, the shop and a note
- Share a product straight from Safari, Amazon or IKEA into a project
- Keep quotes, contracts and receipts as documents
- Notes for everything else - the carpenter's number, the paint code

BEFORE, DURING AND AFTER
- A photo timeline for the whole project
- Side-by-side before and after comparison
- Slideshow to show people what changed

TASKS THAT DO NOT GET FORGOTTEN
- Due dates and reminders (Pro)
- Built-in time tracking with a Lock Screen timer and Dynamic Island (iPhone 14 Pro and later)
- Home Screen widgets for budget progress and what is next

FREE, WITH A ONE-TIME PRO UPGRADE
Unlimited projects, items, photos, notes, documents, time tracking, widgets, local backups and full data export are free, and stay free. Pro is a single purchase - no subscription, nothing to cancel - and adds the budget chart, task reminders, PDF export, iCloud sync and project sharing. Family Sharing included.

PRIVACY
- No account and no sign-up
- You
